summary_en: One-year ruling for 1974 only: because the solemnity of the Immaculate Conception falls on the Second Sunday of Advent in 1974 and would otherwise be anticipated to Saturday, Paul VI concedes that, at the judgement of each Episcopal Conference, it may be celebrated on Sunday 8 December 1974 notwithstanding the Advent Sunday; notice signed by the Secretary, no protocol number printed.
excerpt: Pluribus Episcopis petentibus, Summus Pontifex Paulus VI concedit ut celebratio liturgica B. Mariae V. Immaculatae anno 1974 de iudicio Conferentiae Episcoporum peragi possit die 8 decembris, dominica Adventus non obstante.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Matris Ecclesiae

summary_en: Grants that the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title Mother of the Church, patroness of the diocese, may be kept throughout the diocese 'Alanopolitana' on 11 October; the diocese could not be identified with certainty from the Latin name, so the nation is left null.
excerpt: Alanopolitana, 19 oct. 1972 (Prot. n. 1402/72): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Matris Ecclesiae, Patronae dioecesis, peragi valeat in tota dioecesi die 11 octobris.

summary_en: One-year ruling for 1972 only: in the city of Goa the feast of St Francis Xavier may be celebrated on 3 December 1972 even though it coincides with the First Sunday of Advent, and elsewhere in the archdiocese of Goa and Daman either the Sunday or the feast may be kept that day (the same protocol also grants a pilgrims' votive Mass at the Bom Jesus basilica, not recorded).
excerpt: Goana et Damanensis, 16 oct. 1972 (Prot. n. 1357/72): conceditur ut in civitate Goana festum S. Francisci Xavier celebretur hoc anno die 3 decembris etiamsi eadem die occurrat Prima Dominica Adventus; in tota Archidioecesi celebrari potest, eadem die huius anni, vel Prima Dominica Adventus vel festum S. Francisci Xavier.

summary_en: One-year ruling for 1973 only: in all churches of the archdiocese of Prague the celebration of St Adalbert, bishop and martyr, may be kept on 23 April 1973, Monday within the Easter octave, because the millennium celebrations of the see of Prague open that day; nation coded CZ for Czechoslovakia per the guide.

summary_en: Instruction 'Normae circa Patronos constituendos' of the Congregation for Divine Worship (19 March 1973, AAS 65, pp. 276-279; no protocol number printed) fixing how patrons rank in calendars: the patron of a place (town or city), moral person, association, institute or group is celebrated as a solemnity with precedence over all feasts of the general or particular calendar and over Sundays of Christmas Time and Ordinary Time; the patron of a diocese, province, region, nation or wider territory, or of a religious province, is celebrated as a feast, which for pastoral reasons may be raised to a solemnity; secondary patrons formerly constituted are celebrated as obligatory memorials.
excerpt: 12. Celebratio Patroni loci vel oppidi vel civitatis, personae moralis, sodalitatis, instituti, coetus, peragitur gradu sollemnitatis. Quae sollemnitas gaudet praecedentia super omnia festa in Calendario generali vel particulari inscripta et super dominicas temporis Nativitatis et « per annum ». Celebratio Patroni dioecesis, provinciae, regionis, nationis aut amplioris territorii et provinciae religiosae peragitur gradu festi. [...] 14. Patroni secundarii olim constituti celebrentur gradu memoriae obligatoriae.
